notes.title: Caption Contest: What does the emo dragon say?
notes.notes: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35483930/ce0fcd2cb77d37524765d9e74f4e39cd84ed6eea.png[/img]Flagon the immortal emo dragon spirit is depressed. He has a lot of reasons to be depressed, besides being a secondary character in a shitty 8-bit JRPG parody. Write a caption to explain what Flagon is saying or thinking. The developers will announce their favorite before the game release and give you a free game download key!
